headline: Non-Formal Kindergarten / ZEIA Studio
context: A Citadel for Children - The non-formal kindergarten is conceived as a house for Rroma children from disadvantaged families. Initiated by Casa Bună Association and built with the support of volunteers, the project is shaped by a collective effort.
